items.how_to_judge: The operator tries the finished isolated result and alone judges it, with regression/reversion and full-suite evidence available. Inspect the last report, observation time and age, reported next step, honest saved-information labeling, and preserved SDLC authority. Automated success is not human acceptance or measured saved effort.
items.statement: Watch shows what Codex last reported, when, and the reported next step; an isolated result is shown for the operator to try; the operator alone judges that final result.
